title: Sunrise on the Reaping Director Keeps Secrets About Haymitch and Maysilee
summary:
The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping arrives in theaters on November 20, 2026, bringing Suzanne Collins's 2025 book to the big screen. The story follows Haymitch Abernathy, played by Joseph Zada, and his fellow District 12 tribute Maysilee Donner, played by McKenna Grace.

Director Francis Lawrence, who has directed every Hunger Games movie except the first, recently talked about the bond between the two characters. He said he spent a lot of time with Zada and Grace during rehearsals in Spain, talking constantly about Haymitch and Maysilee. Lawrence said the three of them kept some secrets about the relationship to help shape how the characters act toward each other.

One detail fascinates Lawrence: even though Haymitch and Maysilee have known each other their entire lives, she slams the door in his face when she sees him. Lawrence said there may be other parts of their story that Collins has not written about, and the actors use their private ideas to understand why the two clash and why they bond.

Fans of the earlier books may already know something about this pair. In Catching Fire, published in 2009, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark watch footage of the 50th Games, where Haymitch and Maysilee formed an alliance against double the usual number of tributes. Maysilee also connects to Katniss: Peeta points out that Katniss's mockingjay pin came from the Donner family, and Maysilee's twin sister Merrilee is the mother of Katniss's friend Madge.

This time, there are four District 12 tributes instead of two, and Haymitch first tries to avoid teaming up with anyone. The youngest is Louella McCoy, whom Haymitch has protected since they were playground sweethearts. Lawrence also mapped out fun links between Louella and Katniss: both are young, dark-haired, braid-wearing heroines, and Haymitch calls both of them sweetheart.
why_it_matters: It shows how actors and directors build believable friendships on screen, and how a new film can deepen a story fans already know.
